Changes:
  * paths from the repository root (package here); output in 05_combinatorial/output/<run_name>/
  * parameters in the YAML header (Knit with Parameters...)
  * group_col: "" = single-group CFA, as the May runs actually did (the May notebook asked for
    group_col = "SYSTEM", a column that does not exist, so lavaan silently fitted one group).

  * max_models and max_reliable_sets_kept_per_scale: 0 = no limit. The May notebook had
    max_models = 1000, which cut the runs at thresholds 0.70-0.72.
The defaults reproduce the final May run (threshold 0.78, 6/4/3): expected 144 candidate models, 118 approved.

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

positive_int_or_zero <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) != 1 || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) || x < 1) return(0L)
  as.integer(x)
}
limit_or_null <- function(x) if (positive_int_or_zero(x) > 0) as.integer(x) else NULL
```

# Purpose

Each row of the combination file is one candidate item set for one scale. The workflow:

- computes alpha and omega total for each predefined scale combination;
- keeps only combinations that pass the reliability threshold (alpha **or** omega);
- crosses the kept visualization, task cognition and system combinations into CFA models;
- fits and ranks the CFA models.

A model passes if:

- TLI >= 0.95 **or** CFI >= 0.95
- and SRMR <= 0.08 **or** RMSEA <= 0.06
- and each scale has alpha >= threshold **or** omega total >= threshold

# Helper Functions

```{r helper-functions}
required_scales <- c("visualization", "task_cognition", "system")

parse_item_list <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[\"']", "") %>%
    stringr::str_split(",") %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    purrr::discard(~ is.na(.x) || .x == "")
}

items_to_label <- function(items) paste(items, collapse = " + ")
items_to_id <- function(items) paste(items, collapse = "__")

make_lavaan_model <- function(visualization_items, task_items, system_items) {
  paste(
    paste0("visualization =~ ", items_to_label(visualization_items)),
    paste0("task_cognition =~ ", items_to_label(task_items)),
    paste0("system =~ ", items_to_label(system_items)),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}

coerce_items_numeric <- function(data, item_cols) {
  data %>%
    mutate(across(
      all_of(item_cols),
      ~ {
        if (is.factor(.x)) as.numeric(as.character(.x))
        else if (is.character(.x)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))
        else as.numeric(.x)
      }
    ))
}

safe_alpha <- function(data, items) {
  out <- tryCatch({
    suppressWarnings(psych::alpha(data[, items, drop = FALSE], check.keys = FALSE))$total$raw_alpha
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  as.numeric(out)
}

safe_omega_total <- function(data, items) {
  out <- tryCatch({
    suppressWarnings(psych::omega(data[, items, drop = FALSE], nfactors = 1, plot = FALSE))$omega.tot
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  as.numeric(out)
}

reliability_for_scale <- function(data, items, scale_name, threshold) {
  alpha <- safe_alpha(data, items)
  omega_total <- safe_omega_total(data, items)
  tibble(
    alpha = alpha,
    omega_total = omega_total,
    reliability_pass = (!is.na(alpha) && alpha >= threshold) || (!is.na(omega_total) && omega_total >= threshold)
  )
}

extract_fit <- function(fit) {
  wanted <- c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr", "chisq", "df", "pvalue", "aic", "bic")
  measures <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit)
  present <- intersect(wanted, names(measures))
  values <- as.list(rep(NA_real_, length(wanted)))
  names(values) <- toupper(wanted)
  for (m in present) values[[toupper(m)]] <- as.numeric(measures[[m]])
  tibble::as_tibble(values)
}

safe_cfa <- function(model_syntax, data, group_col, use_grouped_cfa, estimator, missing) {
  tryCatch({
    if (use_grouped_cfa && !is.null(group_col) && group_col %in% names(data)) {
      lavaan::cfa(
        model_syntax,
        data = data,
        group = group_col,
        estimator = estimator,
        missing = missing,
        std.lv = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      lavaan::cfa(
        model_syntax,
        data = data,
        estimator = estimator,
        missing = missing,
        std.lv = TRUE
      )
    }
  }, error = function(e) e)
}

fit_one_candidate <- function(row, data, group_col, use_grouped_cfa, estimator, missing,
                              fit_rule_cfi_tli, fit_rule_srmr, fit_rule_rmsea,
                              reliability_threshold, save_fit = FALSE) {
  visualization_items <- row$visualization_items[[1]]
  task_items <- row$task_cognition_items[[1]]
  system_items <- row$system_items[[1]]

  model_syntax <- make_lavaan_model(visualization_items, task_items, system_items)
  #print(reliability_threshold)
  rel_visualization <- reliability_for_scale(data, visualization_items, "visualization", reliability_threshold)
  rel_task <- reliability_for_scale(data, task_items, "task_cognition", reliability_threshold)
  rel_system <- reliability_for_scale(data, system_items, "system", reliability_threshold)

  fit <- safe_cfa(model_syntax, data, group_col, use_grouped_cfa, estimator, missing)

  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    fit_tbl <- tibble(
      CFI = NA_real_, TLI = NA_real_, RMSEA = NA_real_, SRMR = NA_real_,
      CHISQ = NA_real_, DF = NA_real_, PVALUE = NA_real_, AIC = NA_real_, BIC = NA_real_
    )
    converged <- FALSE
    fit_error <- conditionMessage(fit)
    admissible <- NA
  } else {
    fit_tbl <- extract_fit(fit)
    converged <- lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "converged")
    admissible <- tryCatch(lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "post.check"), error = function(e) NA)
    fit_error <- NA_character_
  }

  out <- tibble(
    candidate_id = row$candidate_id,
    visualization_combination_id = row$visualization_combination_id,
    task_cognition_combination_id = row$task_cognition_combination_id,
    system_combination_id = row$system_combination_id,
    visualization_items = items_to_id(visualization_items),
    task_cognition_items = items_to_id(task_items),
    system_items = items_to_id(system_items),
    model_syntax = model_syntax,
    converged = converged,
    admissible = admissible,
    fit_error = fit_error,
    alpha_visualization = rel_visualization$alpha,
    omega_visualization = rel_visualization$omega_total,
    reliability_pass_visualization = rel_visualization$reliability_pass,
    alpha_task_cognition = rel_task$alpha,
    omega_task_cognition = rel_task$omega_total,
    reliability_pass_task_cognition = rel_task$reliability_pass,
    alpha_system = rel_system$alpha,
    omega_system = rel_system$omega_total,
    reliability_pass_system = rel_system$reliability_pass
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(fit_tbl) %>%
    mutate(
      global_fit_pass = (TLI >= fit_rule_cfi_tli | CFI >= fit_rule_cfi_tli) &
        (SRMR <= fit_rule_srmr | RMSEA <= fit_rule_rmsea),
      reliability_pass = reliability_pass_visualization & reliability_pass_task_cognition & reliability_pass_system,
      pass = isTRUE(converged) & isTRUE(global_fit_pass) & isTRUE(reliability_pass)
    )

  if (save_fit && !inherits(fit, "error")) out$fit_object <- list(fit)
  out
}
```

# Load Inputs

```{r load-inputs}
raw_data <- readr::read_csv(data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

combination_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  combination_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(
    scale = col_character(),
    combination = col_character(),
    combination_id = col_character()
  )
)

combination_sets <- combination_raw %>%
  mutate(
    scale = stringr::str_trim(scale),
    combination_id = stringr::str_trim(combination_id),
    items = purrr::map(combination, parse_item_list),
    n_items = purrr::map_int(items, length),
    items_id = purrr::map_chr(items, items_to_id)
  ) %>%
  filter(scale %in% required_scales)

missing_scales <- setdiff(required_scales, unique(combination_sets$scale))
if (length(missing_scales) > 0) {
  stop("The combination file is missing scale(s): ", paste(missing_scales, collapse = ", "))
}

duplicate_combination_ids <- combination_sets %>%
  count(combination_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(duplicate_combination_ids) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate combination_id values found: ", paste(duplicate_combination_ids$combination_id, collapse = ", "))
}

all_source_items <- combination_sets %>%
  pull(items) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique()

missing_items <- setdiff(all_source_items, names(raw_data))
if (length(missing_items) > 0) {
  stop("These combination items are missing from the data: ", paste(missing_items, collapse = ", "))
}

analysis_data <- raw_data %>%
  coerce_items_numeric(all_source_items)

combination_sets %>%
  count(scale, n_items, name = "n_combinations") %>%
  arrange(match(scale, required_scales), n_items) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Calculate Reliability For All Combinations

```{r calculate-reliability}
combination_reliability <- combination_sets %>%
  mutate(
    reliability = purrr::map2(items, scale, ~ reliability_for_scale(
      data = analysis_data,
      items = .x,
      scale_name = .y,
      threshold = params$reliability_threshold
    ))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(reliability) %>%
  mutate(
    reliability_score = pmax(alpha, omega_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    reliability_score = if_else(is.finite(reliability_score), reliability_score, NA_real_)
  )

combination_reliability_file <- file.path(output_dir, "combinations_of_items_by_scale_with_reliability.csv")

readr::write_csv(
  combination_reliability %>%
    select(scale, combination, combination_id, reliability_score, alpha, omega_total, reliability_pass),
  combination_reliability_file
)

cat("Wrote reliability table:", combination_reliability_file, "\n")

combination_reliability %>%
  select(scale, combination_id, reliability_score, alpha, omega_total, reliability_pass) %>%
  slice_head(n = positive_int_or_zero(params$top_n_results)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

# Reliability Prefilter

```{r reliability-prefilter}
reliability_sets <- readr::read_csv(
  combination_reliability_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(
    scale = col_character(),
    combination = col_character(),
    combination_id = col_character(),
    reliability_score = col_double(),
    alpha = col_double(),
    omega_total = col_double(),
    reliability_pass = col_logical()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    scale = stringr::str_trim(scale),
    combination_id = stringr::str_trim(combination_id),
    items = purrr::map(combination, parse_item_list),
    n_items = purrr::map_int(items, length),
    items_id = purrr::map_chr(items, items_to_id)
  ) %>%
  filter(scale %in% required_scales) %>%
  group_by(scale) %>%
  arrange(desc(reliability_pass), desc(reliability_score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank_within_scale = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

readr::write_csv(
  reliability_sets %>%
    select(scale, combination, combination_id, reliability_score, alpha, omega_total, reliability_pass, rank_within_scale),
  file.path(output_dir, "tested_reliability_sets.csv")
)

kept_reliability_sets <- reliability_sets %>%
  group_by(scale) %>%
  group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
    reliable <- .x %>% filter(reliability_pass)

    if (!is.null(max_kept)) {
      reliable <- reliable %>% slice_head(n = max_kept)
    }

    reliable %>% mutate(kept_for_cfa = TRUE)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

readr::write_csv(
  kept_reliability_sets %>%
    select(scale, combination_id, combination, n_items, alpha, omega_total, reliability_pass, reliability_score),
  file.path(output_dir, "kept_reliability_sets_for_cfa.csv")
)

prefilter_summary <- reliability_sets %>%
  left_join(
    kept_reliability_sets %>%
      select(scale, combination_id, kept_for_cfa),
    by = c("scale", "combination_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    kept_for_cfa = coalesce(kept_for_cfa, FALSE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(scale, n_items) %>%
  summarise(
    n_item_sets_evaluated = n(),
    n_reliability_pass = sum(reliability_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_kept_for_cfa = sum(kept_for_cfa, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(prefilter_summary)
```

# Build CFA Candidates

```{r build-candidates}
empty_scales <- setdiff(required_scales, unique(kept_reliability_sets$scale))
if (length(empty_scales) > 0) {
  stop("No item sets remain for scale(s): ", paste(empty_scales, collapse = ", "))
}

visualization_sets <- kept_reliability_sets %>% filter(scale == "visualization")
task_sets <- kept_reliability_sets %>% filter(scale == "task_cognition")
system_sets <- kept_reliability_sets %>% filter(scale == "system")

candidates <- tidyr::crossing(
  visualization_combination_id = visualization_sets$combination_id,
  task_cognition_combination_id = task_sets$combination_id,
  system_combination_id = system_sets$combination_id
) %>%
  mutate(
    visualization_items = visualization_sets$items[match(visualization_combination_id, visualization_sets$combination_id)],
    task_cognition_items = task_sets$items[match(task_cognition_combination_id, task_sets$combination_id)],
    system_items = system_sets$items[match(system_combination_id, system_sets$combination_id)],
    candidate_id = paste(
      visualization_combination_id,
      task_cognition_combination_id,
      system_combination_id,
      sep = "__"
    )
  )

cat("Number of candidate CFA models after reliability prefilter:", nrow(candidates), "\n")

if (!is.null(max_models)) {
  candidates <- candidates %>% slice_head(n = max_models)
}

all_candidate_items <- candidates %>%
  transmute(items = purrr::pmap(list(visualization_items, task_cognition_items, system_items), c)) %>%
  pull(items) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique()

cat("Number of candidate CFA models to fit:", nrow(candidates), "\n")
cat("Number of unique item columns used:", length(all_candidate_items), "\n")

tibble(n_candidate_models = nrow(candidates)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Run CFA and Reliability Exploration

```{r run-exploration}
started_at <- Sys.time()
progress_every <- positive_int_or_zero(params$progress_every)

results <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(candidates)), function(i) {
  if (progress_every > 0 && i %% progress_every == 0) {
    cat("Fitting candidate", i, "of", nrow(candidates), "\n")
  }

  fit_one_candidate(
    row = candidates[i, ],
    data = analysis_data,
    group_col = params$group_col,
    use_grouped_cfa = use_grouped_cfa,
    estimator = params$estimator,
    missing = params$missing,
    fit_rule_cfi_tli = params$fit_rule_cfi_tli,
    fit_rule_srmr = params$fit_rule_srmr,
    fit_rule_rmsea = params$fit_rule_rmsea,
    reliability_threshold = params$reliability_threshold,
    save_fit = params$save_fitted_models
  )
})

finished_at <- Sys.time()
cat("Started:", format(started_at), "\n")
cat("Finished:", format(finished_at), "\n")
cat("Elapsed:", round(as.numeric(difftime(finished_at, started_at, units = "mins")), 2), "minutes\n")
```

# Filter and Rank

```{r filter-rank}
ranked_results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    min_reliability = pmin(
      pmax(alpha_visualization, omega_visualization, na.rm = TRUE),
      pmax(alpha_task_cognition, omega_task_cognition, na.rm = TRUE),
      pmax(alpha_system, omega_system, na.rm = TRUE),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    fit_score = rowMeans(cbind(CFI, TLI, 1 - pmin(RMSEA, 1), 1 - pmin(SRMR, 1)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pass), desc(global_fit_pass), desc(reliability_pass), desc(CFI), desc(TLI), RMSEA, SRMR, desc(min_reliability))

passing_models <- ranked_results %>% filter(pass)

cat("Total fitted candidates:", nrow(results), "\n")
cat("Converged candidates:", sum(results$converged, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Passing candidates:", nrow(passing_models), "\n")

results %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_converged = sum(converged, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_global_fit_pass = sum(global_fit_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_reliability_pass = sum(reliability_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pass = sum(pass, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Best Models

```{r best-models}
top_n <- positive_int_or_zero(params$top_n_results)

ranked_results %>%
  select(
    candidate_id, pass, converged, admissible,
    CFI, TLI, RMSEA, SRMR,
    alpha_visualization, omega_visualization,
    alpha_task_cognition, omega_task_cognition,
    alpha_system, omega_system,
    visualization_combination_id, task_cognition_combination_id, system_combination_id,
    visualization_items, task_cognition_items, system_items
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
results %>%
  count(pass, global_fit_pass, reliability_pass, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(pass), desc(global_fit_pass), desc(reliability_pass)) %>%
  knitr::kable()

if (any(!results$converged, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  results %>%
    filter(!converged) %>%
    count(fit_error, sort = TRUE, name = "n") %>%
    slice_head(n = positive_int_or_zero(params$max_diagnostic_errors)) %>%
    knitr::kable()
}
```

# Export Results

```{r export-results}
results_file <- file.path(output_dir, "all_reliability_cfa_results.csv")
passing_file <- file.path(output_dir, "passing_reliability_cfa_results.csv")
best_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("top_", positive_int_or_zero(params$top_n_results), "_reliability_cfa_results.csv"))
syntax_file <- file.path(output_dir, "passing_reliability_cfa_model_syntax.txt")

readr::write_csv(ranked_results %>% select(-any_of("fit_object")), results_file)
readr::write_csv(passing_models %>% select(-any_of("fit_object")), passing_file)
readr::write_csv(ranked_results %>% slice_head(n = positive_int_or_zero(params$top_n_results)) %>% select(-any_of("fit_object")), best_file)

if (nrow(passing_models) > 0) {
  syntax_text <- passing_models %>%
    mutate(block = paste0(
      "# ", candidate_id, "\n",
      "# CFI=", round(CFI, 3), ", TLI=", round(TLI, 3),
      ", RMSEA=", round(RMSEA, 3), ", SRMR=", round(SRMR, 3), "\n",
      model_syntax, "\n"
    )) %>%
    pull(block) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n")
  writeLines(syntax_text, syntax_file)
} else {
  writeLines("No passing models found under the current rules.", syntax_file)
}

cat("Wrote:\n")
cat(results_file, "\n")
cat(passing_file, "\n")
cat(best_file, "\n")
cat(syntax_file, "\n")
```


# Comparison with the May 2026 run

```{r compare-may}
may_dir <- here::here("Gdrive_files", "Item Reduction", "Reliability_CFA_Analysis", "4_factors_task_cognition",
                      "260506Data_AnalysisReliability078-4taskCFAExploration-100best")
may_file <- file.path(may_dir, "R78-4passing_reliability_cfa_results.csv")
if (params$run_name == "rel078_6-4-3_singlegroup_uncollapsed" && file.exists(may_file)) {
  may <- readr::read_csv(may_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  key <- function(d) paste(d$visualization_items, d$task_cognition_items, d$system_items)
  cat("Approved now:", nrow(passing_models), "| approved in May:", nrow(may), "\n")
  cat("Same approved models:", setequal(key(passing_models), key(may)), "\n")
  both <- dplyr::inner_join(passing_models %>% mutate(k = key(.)), may %>% mutate(k = key(.)), by = "k")
  cat("Max |CFI difference|:", max(abs(both$CFI.x - both$CFI.y)), "\n")
}
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(output_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
```
